nav: App chrome: status bar plus a clickable bottom trace rail
hero: Console already running at T-minus 04:00, no title stage
seq: One 11vh pinned console act (6 phases) then one 1.3vh pinned close; 12.3vh
close: Command-line email input
sig: Scroll playhead over a persistent trace rail that stamps each phase and jumps on click
peak: You fly a telescope to 1.5 million km under your own scroll and watch the signal delay reach five seconds.

nav: Left-edge index of the five projects (names, jumps to the object)
hero: Object one (Harbour Reading Room) already in view with its museum label, no title treatment
seq: One lateral pan spine of five objects, 6.5vh, plus a 1vh inquiry plate; 8.5vh, 2 acts
close: Inquiry plate typeset exactly like an object label (Site, Brief, Reply within three working days) holding the form
sig: A section drawing that draws itself under each object as it crosses the centre (SVG stroke driven by --sc-p), dimension callouts arriving after the line
peak: Court of Seven Stairs is the widest panel with the longest dwell; the seven stairs draw themselves under the light.

nav: Fixed bottom strip of the six materials; choosing one jumps to the next object made of it
hero: Object one (Low Table) already framed, labelled with the same schema as every object, no pitch
seq: Vertical museum wall: flow acts with staggered reveal and tilt per object, no pan, no pin; 9vh, 8 short flow acts
close: Final object plate where a material picker re-sorts which objects are listed, then the inquiry line
sig: A material temperature control: the swatch under the pointer regrades the whole wall (warm for wood and rust, cool for stone and steel) all at once
peak: The wall changes temperature under your hand as you move across the materials.

nav: Fixed 12-month calendar bar across the top; months jump to the crop that is in the ground then
hero: First crop story (faba beans) already in view, labelled with sow and harvest months
seq: Season-driven pan (Jan to Dec is the scroll axis) 5.5vh, then a pinned rotation board 2vh, then one flow row; 9vh, 3 acts
close: A sowing-plan form where choosing a crop rewrites its calendar bar live, then the contact line
sig: The season sweep: one vertical line travels the calendar as you scroll and each crop card changes stage (sow, grow, harvest) as it is crossed, with the still graded to match
peak: A whole farming year passes under one line and the rye is the last thing left standing.

nav: Margin folio: chapter number and title updating in the left margin
hero: Title page: the statement set in type on paper, no media above the fold
seq: Five chapters on hard-cut grounds, 9vh total, flow plus parallax column, one scrub chapter allowed
close: Colophon: small type, the CTA set as a line of running text
sig: A soil-core strip in the margin that grows downward as you read, each chapter adding a labelled layer with a real measured value from the content
peak: The margin grows a soil core that gets deeper with every chapter you read.

nav: A thin route line down the right edge with a stop per journey chapter (clickable)
hero: Title page set as a ticket stub, type only, no media
seq: Seven journey chapters, 11vh, flow only with a reveal wipe between chapters, no scrub
close: A running-text sentence with fill-in blanks (when, who) that is also the form
sig: The route line fills in as chapters pass and a day-counter sums the days of the journeys you have read, using the days stated in the content
peak: You read a travel year and the route line along the edge draws the whole slow trip.

nav: Film-edge frame counter in the margin (No. 07 style) that jumps between series
hero: Title page with one line of type and one empty frame rectangle, no image yet
seq: Six chapters (one per series), 10.5vh, hard-cut dark grounds, media in a captioned column, one scrub allowed
close: A print-order plate set like a caption under a photograph
sig: A light meter: scroll sets the exposure so the stills lift and fall in grade while a readout shows an f-stop and a shutter time
peak: You scroll and the exposure of the whole page opens until the light holds a little longer.

nav: The divider is the chrome: labels For people and For clinicians plus argument progress
hero: 50/50 first screen, both headlines readable at once
seq: One long pin (9vh, four beats) with the divider driven from --sc-p
close: The collapse: the divider travels to the left edge and the clinician column takes the full width holding the CTA
sig: One heartbeat trace that crosses the divider and speeds up with scroll speed, linking both columns' content
peak: The divider slides away and one waveform ends up carrying both sides of care.

nav: The divider carries Question and Answer labels and a typed-question field
hero: 50/50 with a question typing out on the left and a mentor's answer arriving on the right
seq: Four short pins (1.8vh each) per question, then a flow beat; 9vh, 5 acts
close: The answer column collapses to full width and the CTA is a typed question input
sig: Type any question and the page returns the nearest cohort or mentor from the real content by keyword match
peak: You type a question into the page and it answers with a cohort that starts soon.

nav: Divider labels Today and With the toolkit, with a per-neighbourhood tab on the divider
hero: A city map cut down the middle, left in the old state, right in the improved state
seq: Three short pins, one per neighbourhood (5vh) plus a final pin (2vh); 7vh, 4 acts
close: The divider collapses to the right edge and the improved column holds the CTA
sig: A draggable divider you can pull to compare minutes-to-find-a-service before and after, from the real bar values; scroll moves it too
peak: You drag the line across the city and the wait times fall under your finger.

nav: App chrome: top account tabs (Cash positions, Risk radar, Playbooks) and a status line
hero: The reconcile table already populated with unmatched lines flagged
seq: One 8vh pinned surface cycling three tabs, then a 1.2vh pinned first-run close; 9.2vh
close: A first-run stepper (connect a bank, pick entities, confirm) with a real field at step one
sig: A running reconcile: the unreconciled total ticks to 0.00 as you scroll, one line clearing at a time, computed from the table data
peak: The unmatched total counts down to exactly zero while you scroll.

nav: App chrome: left sidebar of the five workflow steps (Ingest, Retrieve, Reason, Review, Ship), clickable
hero: A code editor already executing the invoice-triage workflow with a live log
seq: One 7vh pinned editor stepping through the five steps, then a 1.2vh pinned run console; 8.2vh
close: A real Run button that executes the workflow on pasted invoice text in the browser (labelled sample logic)
sig: Scroll is the debugger: it steps execution line by line, the current line highlights, variables fill in, and the log trace grows
peak: You scroll and a workflow runs one line at a time until the bill is booked.

nav: Loud full-width bar with a marquee of the look names and the waitlist CTA at the same weight as the wordmark
hero: One screen that cuts to look two in under a viewport
seq: Fourteen hard-cut acts, none over 1.3vh, no pin; 13vh
close: Abrupt full-bleed waitlist: the last cut is the email field and nothing else
sig: A tape measure that runs along the top and stamps each look with its measurement from the real sizing table as it cuts past
peak: The whole collection cuts past in thirteen screens and a tape measure stamps every look.

nav: Loud bar with a basket counter that adds each recipe as its cut passes
hero: One screen of the promise that hard-cuts to the first recipe
seq: Twelve cuts at 0.8 to 1.2vh, no pin, tiles shaped as recipe cards; 10vh
close: Abrupt full-bleed 'Stock the good stuff' with a household-size input
sig: A kitchen timer that jumps to each cut's cooking time and keeps a running receipt of the minutes of every recipe you pass, from the real recipe times
peak: You scroll past a week of dinners and the timer totals how long they all take.

nav: Loud toolbar of the six tools as tabs that jump to their cut
hero: Cut one: the tagline on the looped film, cutting to the first tool inside one viewport
seq: Eight cuts that return to cut one, 9vh, circular structure, no pin
close: Abrupt CTA cut whose button restarts the loop, with an email field
sig: The page is a loop: scrolling past the last cut re-enters the first with the next release note in focus, so it never hits a footer
peak: You scroll past the end and the page starts again with a new release note.

nav: Fixed minimal bar at the bottom centre carrying the now-playing track title and one CTA
hero: Full-bleed scrub of the ripple film with a corner-anchored greet headline
seq: scrub, pin (track list), flow (room specs), scrub, pinned close; 5 acts, 10.4vh
close: Pinned spotlight close with a date input for Book a session
sig: Spatial mixer: the pointer position pans the track list across a stereo field that is drawn and audible-less (a visual meter), moving each track's level meter
peak: The room opens around you as the ripple film scrubs under your hand.

nav: Fixed minimal bar at the top with a live time-of-day dial instead of a menu and one CTA
hero: Slow poster-first scrub of the candle film, greet headline lower-left
seq: scrub, flow (rooms rail), pin (ritual day), pinned close; 4 acts, 9.4vh
close: Pinned close with a stay-dates input and a magnetic CTA
sig: A time-of-day handle: one control that regrades every image, ground and accent from dawn to night together
peak: You turn the day to dusk and the whole house lights its stoves.

nav: No persistent nav; the wordmark is set at composition scale
hero: One line at extreme scale (SMALL SPARKS) filling the viewport, real h1 behind
seq: Six poster acts alternating 40vw words with 16px paragraphs; 8vh
close: Inverts the page: the smallest type on the site, the CTA a plain underlined link
sig: The 48,000 (real, from content) is assembled from tiny dots that gather on screen as you scroll until the number resolves
peak: Forty-eight thousand sparks gather into one number.

nav: None; a single huge unit readout (GW) rides the left edge
hero: The figure 3.1 GW set at 40vw
seq: Five acts, 7.5vh, type that lengthens: project names stretched to their capacity
close: Page inverts to its quietest setting; CTA a plain underlined line
sig: Type as chart: each project name is stretched in width to its real MW so the bars are made of the words themselves
peak: Five project names stretch until together they add up to 3.1 gigawatts.

nav: None; the wordmark is huge and distorts with scroll speed
hero: One cropped word (WEIRD) at 45vw with the real h1 behind it
seq: Six acts, 9vh, faction names at 30vw with archive facts as small print between
close: The ground inverts at 03:17 and the CTA is an underlined wishlist link
sig: A 03:17 clock: scroll maps to the clock, and when it hits 03:17 the ground flips and a faction name changes
peak: The clock reaches 03:17 and the whole page flips.
